answer: Harbor sybil tax: each identity locks a 70-credit bond with the harbor and files a cipher-sealed receipt each epoch, paying 35 first, then 35+5(k-1) for the k-th filing. At the zenith hour the harbor auditor posts the tax table; a reused cipher or underpaid filing burns the bond. Rented receipts fail since each cipher binds one key to one filing, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,532,500 plus 70,000 locked versus 40,000 in rewards. Honest agents pay 35 once.
